senses.gloss: Rocamāna^1, name of several princes. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2654 (incarnation of the Asura Aśvagrīva).--§ 232 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 186, 6990 (present at the svayaṃvara of Draupadī).--§ 279 (Arjuna): II, 27, 1027 (Urugāvāsinaṃ, in the north, vanquished by Arjuna).--§ 280 (Bhīmasena): II, 29, 1066 (Aśvamedheśvaraṃ, in the east, vanquished by Bhīmasena).--§ 554 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 4, 75 (among the princes to whom the Pāṇḍavas ought to send messengers).-§ 572 (Rathātirathasaṅkhyānap.): V, 172, 5921 (a mahāratha in the army of Yudhishṭhira).--§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 23, 996 (proceeded against Droṇa, description of his horses), 1014 (ºsya sutaṃ, do.).--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 56, 2736, 2740 (a Pāñcāla, slain by Karṇa).
Rocamāna^2, dual (ºau). § 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 6, 170 (have been slain by Droṇa).
Rocanāmukha, a Daitya. § 564 (Mātalīyop.): V, 105, 3685 (had been slain by Garuḍa).
